# cloudinary_triggers (Data Source)

Returns all webhook notification triggers configured for the product environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudinary_triggers" "all" {}

output "trigger_count" {
  value = length(data.cloudinary_triggers.all.triggers)
}

output "trigger_uris" {
  value = [for t in data.cloudinary_triggers.all.triggers : t.uri]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `triggers` (Attributes List) List of all configured triggers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--triggers))

<a id="nestedatt--triggers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `triggers`

Read-Only:

- `additive` (Boolean) Whether the trigger is additive.
- `auth_scheme` (String) Signature method.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `event_type` (String) Event that fires the trigger.
- `filter` (String) JSONLogic filter (JSON-encoded).
- `id` (String) Trigger ID.
- `payload_template` (String) Mustache payload template (JSON-encoded).
- `product_environment_id` (String) Product environment scope.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-updated timestamp.
- `uri` (String) Webhook URL.
- `uri_type` (String) URI type (always webhook).
